name: project-guide
description: A simple standard for laying out, naming, and describing projects, with skills to create a new project to it, bring an existing repository up to it, and keep adopted repositories current.

interface.shortDescription: Create and adopt projects to one standard.
interface.longDescription: Conventions for a flat projects root, the standard files every project carries (including a local copy of the conventions and a base block in AGENTS.md), a project.yaml manifest, naming, remotes and visibility, and worktrees, plus skills that create a new project, bring an existing repository up to the standard in place, and keep every adopted repository current with the standard.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start a new project to the standard.
